text: Elias Pettersson's shorthanded goal tied it 2-2 late in the second period, and Tye Kartye took the lead back 89 seconds later. Vancouver never answered. Kartye's second of the night, set up by J.T. Miller and Vladislav Gavrikov, started a stretch in which NYR scored four straight in a 6-2 win. The score matched the play. Shot
